req.title: Include Content-Length on echo responses
req.statement: The system shall include a Content-Length header equal to the response body byte length on echo endpoints.

doc.reasoning: The requirement specifies that the Content-Length header must be included in the response of echo endpoints, matching the byte length of the response body. This ensures that clients can correctly interpret the size of the response. The tests will verify this behavior across different HTTP methods, ensuring compliance with the requirement.

tests.name: test_content_length_header_present
preconditions: The httpbin app is running and accessible.
actions: Send a GET request to the /get endpoint.
expected: The Content-Length header is present and matches the response body length.
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()
response = client.get('/get')
assert response.status_code == 200
content_length = int(response.headers['Content-Length'])
assert content_length == len(response.data)

tests.name: test_content_length_header_missing_on_error
preconditions: The httpbin app is running and accessible.
actions: Send a GET request to the /status/400 endpoint.
expected: The Content-Length header is not required to match the response body length.
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()
response = client.get('/status/400')
assert response.status_code == 400
try:
    content_length = int(response.headers['Content-Length'])
    assert content_length == len(response.data)
except KeyError:
    pass

tests.name: test_content_length_boundary_case
preconditions: The httpbin app is running and accessible.
actions: Send a POST request to the /post endpoint with a small payload.
expected: The Content-Length header matches the response body length.
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()
payload = {'key': 'value'}
response = client.post('/post', data=payload)
assert response.status_code == 200
content_length = int(response.headers['Content-Length'])
assert content_length == len(response.data)
